name: Gathering the Cure
objectiveText: Bring 5 Earthroot and 12 Lunar Funguses to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine so she may make a curative salve. Earthroot  ( 5 ) Lunar Fungus  ( 12 )

comments.body:
Lunar Fungas is found inside small spotted mushrooms  in the following Moonkin caves South East of Audbodine (spelling).  These mushrooms stick out because they will be the only one spotted, but are also one of the smallest which makes them hard to spot at first.  I found all 12 in the 3 caves at 

(43,48), (43,50), (42,52).

YOU DO NOT NEED HERBALISM TO GATHER THESE, they are a quest item and the wheel will appear when you mouse over them.

Anyone looking for Lunar Fungus should go to the Moonkin Caves to the east of Auberdine. Once you kill the Moonkin in each cave (there are three caves), look around the cave touching your mouse pointer on each mushroom you see on the floor. You'll see the cursor suddenly change to the search icon, stand by the mushroom and right click on it. You'll notice a status bar appear, when it fills you'll be presented with either 1 or 2 bits of Lunar fungus.
replies: There are actually 5 caves. As you head east from Auber, there are three caves running north-south, but there are two more caves behind them. I was able to get all 12 fungus from a single trip to each of those 5 caves. (One cave have duals in each of three pods, while two caves had only singles in one pod, so YMMV.)
Blighty, best information yet. thanks. Once I saw a mushroom, I could find others.

1: If you're a herbalist, you can see earthroot *and* lunar fungus on your minimap. Don't forget you can always abandon the skill later, so it's worth taking it up and skilling it up a bit so you can pick your own Earthroots - instead of blowing your load on AH, you could even make a profit from the quest!

2: Earthroot grows mostly in rocky areas, such as on the outside of caves, base/top of hills/mountains/rocks... If you're experienced in mining, earthroot likes the same areas as mineral deposits, although it only grows outdoors in my experience so don't bother looking inside caves.

3: Lunar Fungus is small, and other mushrooms in the cave are also small. The easiest way to identify Lunar Fungus without waving your cursor over everything is to look for the mushrooms with spotted tops; all the scenery mushrooms have plain-coloured caps.

If you are not a herbalist, Earthroot can also be dropped from the Timberlings near Dolanaar in Teldrassil.

There is also a Vendor in the wetlands that sells Earthroot for 80 copper each. He is near the prospector you run into along the side of the road
heading away from the harbor.

Go in the Moonkin caves, and you'll find little mushrooms(red with white spots, i think). Collect twelve of them. For Earthroot, either go to dolanaar and kill millions of Timberlings, or take the left boat at Auberdine. This will take you to Menethil Bay. Make sure you open the flight route. Follow the road leading to Loch Modan. Note: STAY ON THE ROAD IF YOU ARE AT THE LEVEL THIS QUEST IS INTENDED FOR. There are level 20+ creeps around. After you head down enough, there will be a little vendor who sells herbs. If the doesn't give you enough, follow the road and head to Ironforge. Again, STAY ON THE ROAD. After you pass many tunnels, the level of the creeps get a bit lower so you can relax a bit. When you get to Ironforge, be sure to open the flight routes. Head to the auction area and hope someone has some Earthroot to sell. Afterwards, you can fly back to Menethil Bay (if you opened both flight routes) and take the boat back to Auberdine.
